title: CloudScale Orchestrator
description: An enterprise-grade cloud resource scaling engine designed to monitor Kubernetes deployments and dynamically re-allocate nodes.
longDescription: CloudScale Orchestrator is a robust solution addressing cold-start times and overhead costs in cloud systems. Utilizing a prediction model, it scales cluster nodes ahead of peak usage periods, achieving up to 40% cloud cost reductions.

title: Aura AI Chat
description: A real-time AI-powered assistant featuring multi-agent capabilities, memory retention, and file semantic analysis.
longDescription: Aura AI Chat connects LLM models with local documents using a vector database. It includes a custom Next.js frontend with drag-and-drop file upload, real-time message streaming, and agent management layouts.
